As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

This is an on-site role in Riyadh. Your main job is helping office staff with their everyday IT problems, from software and account issues to connectivity, along with looking after the hardware they use. That side of the role covers handing out equipment, receiving and checking returned devices, and registering everything in the hardware asset management system. When the Riyadh office has no user issues to handle and no equipment to process, you turn to the remote Service Desk ticket queue. We are looking for someone dependable who can work through unfamiliar problems independently and see them through to a fix.
Being the first point of contact for IT requests, whether someone walks up to the desk or submits a request through the ticketing system, by email, or over chat.
Triaging, prioritizing, resolving, and escalating Service Desk tickets within Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets.
Supporting end-user hardware and software, including laptops and desktops, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, and meeting-room and AV equipment.

Handing out and collecting devices, running basic diagnostics to decide whether to repair a device or send it for service, coordinating repairs with the relevant provider, and keeping hardware asset and software-license records accurate.
Setting up equipment and accounts for new hires, and collecting devices and deactivating accounts when staff leave.
Administering user accounts across multiple systems.
Supporting off-site users remotely using remote-access and diagnostic tools.
Keeping the Service Desk knowledge base up to date with accurate processes and procedures.
Working as part of an international team.
At least 2 years of experience in an IT Service Desk or desktop support role, ideally in an enterprise environment.
A Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
Fluent English and Arabic, both written and spoken (mandatory).
Experience supporting end-user devices throughout their lifecycle, including new-hire onboarding and offboarding.
Experience with Active Directory, including creating and managing user accounts and distribution lists, resetting passwords, and unlocking accounts.
Familiarity with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow to manage and track your workload.
Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Windows (Windows 11; Windows 10 a plus) and macOS.
Comfortable juggling several issues at once and handling support requests in real time.
A proactive attitude to customer service, with the ability to work under pressure and on your own.
Comfortable handling physical equipment, including lifting and moving devices and accessories when needed.
Willing to learn new products and technologies through lab time, self-study, and available support resources.
Comfortable working with users at any level of technical knowledge.
Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Exchange, Entra ID, Jamf, or Intune.
ITIL, CompTIA A+, Microsoft role-based certifications such as MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), or similar.
Experience with incident monitoring and management systems.
Scripting and automation skills with tools like PowerShell.
Working week from Sunday to Thursday, starting at 9:00 AM, with Friday and Saturday off.
Occasionally the role may need some flexibility outside standard hours, for example during office moves or events. This is arranged ahead of time and agreed with you first.

Location Sheikh Khalifa Bin Salman Highway, Al Seef District, Manama, BahrainVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about mixing drinks. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our bartenders have the basics down, but are constantly on the look-out for new trends, micro-local offerings, and guests’ evolving needs. They are not just a beverage enthusiast, but also the host of the space. Their role goes beyond the bar itself to take ownership of guest service more broadly and do what needs to be done. Bartenders will use their knowledge and expertise to make the bar look and function flawlessly. They will build relationships with others across the hotel and in the community, to anticipate and deliver on our guests’ needs. They should be passionate about the guest service experience, but also have an eye for detail – from the money that moves through their hands, to the information they provide to guests, to the quality of their drinks.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, protecting company assets, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring your uniform and personal appearance are professional. Bartenders will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time) and taking a hands-on approach to their work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Bartenders – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

في ويستن، نحن ملتزمون بتمكين الضيوف من استعادة السيطرة وتعزيز رفاهيتهم عندما يكونون في أمس الحاجة إليها أثناء السفر، مما يضمن قدرتهم على أن يكونوا أفضل نسخة من أنفسهم. لتحقيق مهمة العلامة التجارية المتمثلة في أن تصبح العلامة التجارية الرائدة في مجال العافية في مجال الضيافة، نحتاج إلى شركاء متحمسين ومشاركين لإضفاء الحيوية على البرامج الفريدة للعلامة التجارية. نريد أن يتبنى شركاؤنا ممارسات الرفاهية الخاصة بهم داخل وخارج الممتلكات. أنت المرشح المثالي لويستن إذا كنت متحمسًا؛ أنت نشط وتفخر بكيفية الحفاظ على رفاهيتك؛ أنت متفائل؛ أنت مغامر. كن في المكان الذي يمكنك فيه القيام بأفضل أعمالك، وابدأ هدفك ، وانتمي إلى فريق عالمي مذهل ، لتصبح أفضل نسخة منك.

d: The Manager – Finance Operations will be embedded within the City Operations Finance & Control team, providing dedicated finance operations, contract and commercial support to the Workers accommodation team

The role will manage the day-to-day invoice validation and processing, contract administration, commercial documentation and reporting for Workers Village contractors and service providers. Working closely with the Workers Village team, Finance & Control and suppliers, the role will ensure contractor charges are appropriately validated, supported, approved and processed through the Horizon system, with clear visibility of outstanding actions, risks and payments.
As Workers Village activity and contractor volumes grow, the role will provide the dedicated commercial and financial control needed to support effective operations.
q: 8+ years' relevant experience across finance operations, commercial management, contract administration, invoicing or related roles.
Strong experience managing contractor invoicing, validation, approvals and payment processes, ideally in a high-volume operational environment.
Experience supporting large operational/service contracts, preferably within workforce accommodation, FM, O&M, hospitality, infrastructure or similar environments.
Good understanding of contracts and commercial terms, with the ability to validate supplier charges against contractual rates, supporting documentation and operational data.
Experience dealing with volume-based or activity-based billing, such as man-days, headcount, unit rates, service volumes or similar charging mechanisms.
Strong reporting and analytical capability, including maintaining invoice/payment trackers, reconciliations, ageing analysis and management reporting.
Experience with ERP/procure-to-pay systems, ideally Horizon, PRISM, Ariba or equivalent, together with strong Excel skills.
Strong attention to detail and a controls-focused mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues proactively.
Experience within Saudi Arabia/GCC and complex operational environments would be advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Commercial Management, Contract Management or a related discipline.
Relevant Finance, Commercial, Procurement or Contract Management professional qualification would be advantageous.
r: li

d: We are hiring an Operations Lead to run our operations end to end and lead the operations team.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You will own day-to-day delivery, manage the relationship with stakeholders, run governance and reporting, and make sure service levels are met. You will carry full responsibility for how the operation is run, from planning and process design to getting the work done when the team needs support.
We are looking for someone who is organized, decisive and dependable, who can manage several priorities at once and deliver to a high standard without close supervision.
Own day-to-day operations and make sure work is delivered accurately and on time.
Track performance against agreed service levels, report on it monthly and put corrective action plans in place when targets are missed.
Plan and track the delivery of operational activities, and report progress weekly.
Set up and run manual workarounds where systems are not yet in place, and track each one until it is automated.
Step in on hands-on work when the team needs support.
Prepare and present weekly, monthly and quarterly review packs, run the meetings, issue minutes and track actions to closure.
Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders, including technology providers, marketing, support teams and external partners.
Coordinate with external partners to get the information and approvals the operation needs.
Escalate critical risks, issues and decisions promptly, with an impact assessment and a proposed solution.
Manage scope changes: assess the impact on resources, timelines and cost, and get approval before changes take effect.
Lead, train and coach the operations team, and set clear priorities and standards.
Plan the team's schedule and workload so the operation is always covered.
Review the team's work for accuracy, especially manual adjustments and other sensitive transactions.
Work closely with the finance team on reconciliations, settlements and approvals.
Write and maintain the operating model and standard operating procedures, with clear owners.
Keep live registers of issues, actions and operational risks, and report on them monthly.
Own operational reporting and dashboards, and turn the data into insights and recommendations.
Define the data the operation needs, check its quality and follow up on gaps and faults with the technology provider.
Recommend improvements to processes, tools and the overall offering.
Keep records ready for audit and support audits when needed.
Support other activities as required by the business.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Management or a related field.
At least 7 years of experience in operations, service delivery or program management, including at least 2 years leading a team.
Experience managing senior stakeholders and running regular review meetings.
Experience working to service levels and delivering regular reports to deadlines.
Experience writing standard operating procedures and improving processes.
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including building reports and dashboards from data.
Well-organized and able to manage several priorities and deadlines at once.
Takes ownership, makes decisions and follows through without being chased.
Detail-oriented and holds the team to a high standard of accuracy.
Calm under pressure and able to handle escalations professionally.
Excellent spoken and written English, including clear and professional emails and presentations.
Experience working with technology providers on system issues and changes.
Experience in loyalty programs, rewards, payments, events, sports or other transaction-based businesses.
Project management or process improvement qualification (for example PMP, PRINCE2 or Lean Six Sigma).
